user_results.title: Store a number with MAdd and use it in an expression
user_results.expected: MUse replaces the selected 4 in 3+4 with 123456; result 123459
user_results.comment: MAdd stored 123456 and MUse replaced the selected operand in 3+4; the grouped result equals 123459.

user_results.title: Insert a stored value at a mid-expression caret
user_results.actual: The hold produced a text-selection toolbar, so MUse insertion at an empty caret was not proven.
user_results.comment: The user-facing control was not available to this emulator run.

user_results.title: Open the calculator memory list
user_results.expected: Saved value 123456 is visible in View memory
user_results.actual: Calculator overflow did not expose View memory: ['MySpace home', 'MySpace', 'CALCULATOR', 'History', 'World time', 'More options', '3+4', '= 7', 'Toggle the scientific keys', 'Open the extra keys', 'AC', '( )', '%', '÷', '7', '8', '9', '×', '4', '5', '6', '−', '1', '2', '3', '+', '0', '.', '⌫', '=', 'Apps', 'Clock', 'Calculator']
user_results.comment: The user-facing control was not available to this emulator run.

user_results.title: Choose a calculator keypress effect
user_results.expected: Effects picker opens and accepts an animation choice
user_results.actual: choices=✓ Spring · bounce back with overshoot; Pulse · quick fade pulse; bounce; Pulse; fade; pulse; selected one option
user_results.comment: The Effects picker exposed user-selectable calculator animation options. This smoke test confirms access and selection, not frame-by-frame animation timing.

user_results.title: Select a calculator key theme
user_results.expected: Key-theme picker exposes Rose and applies a visible keypad palette
user_results.actual: Could not return to calculator controls through MySpace's Apps route: ['Tue, Oct 27', 'Home', 'Phone', 'Messages', 'MySpace', 'Predicted app: MySpace', 'Chrome', 'Camera', 'Search', 'Google app', 'Voice search', 'Google Lens']
user_results.comment: The user-facing control was not available to this emulator run.

limits: Direct APK evidence comes from Android 14/API 34 emulator UI actions, screenshots and hierarchy dumps.
Only calculator screens and calculator-specific settings are exercised; other MySpace apps are out of scope.
The calculator ad check scans sampled visible text; it is not a network or third-party SDK audit.
Source-CI runs are reported separately from direct APK results.
